svg.title: Balance Tuner Android app: the Drive and Tune PID screens
svg.text: Drive tab, Tune PID tab, and Tune PID scrolled down to auto-tune and the parameters · connected over USB · simulated telemetry

g.text: Hold the spin and horn buttons. Remote mode follows the
stick; Avoid and Follow use the ultrasonic sensor.
Use mean angle as balance angle
The robot tries gains on its own while it balances on the
floor (~1 m free, USB cable slack); stand it up again
whenever it falls. Each trial is scored by a cost (wobble,
gyro, wheel drift and travel, PWM saturation; a fall is worst).
Pick a method in the list. ML (Bayesian): a Gaussian-process
model learns the cost from every trial and picks the most
promising next one; about 15–25 trials for two gains.
Gaussian process + expected improvement. Fewest trials;
Stiffness against tilt. Too low: falls over; too high: fast
Damping from the gyro. Raise to calm the wobble; too high
Holds the wheels still. Too low: drifts away; too high: slow
Pulls back to the start position. The kit uses about Speed Kp
